label: Community health outcomes
description: Describe measurable improvements in Mat-Su community health with baseline data and a measurement plan.

scoring.desc: Health outcomes are not defined or not measurable.
Outcomes are defined for a specific population but baseline or measurement plan is missing.
Outcomes are specific, measurable, grounded in Mat-Su health data, and have a post-project measurement plan.

common_failures: National statistics substituted for Mat-Su data
No measurement beyond the award period

label: Project feasibility
description: Show the project can be executed on the proposed timeline with realistic staffing and methods.

scoring.desc: Timeline or staffing plan is unrealistic.
Plan is plausible but a major risk such as staffing or rural access is unmitigated.
Timeline, staffing, and risk mitigations are explicit and consistent with Mat-Su operating realities.

common_failures: Staffing plan assumes urban hiring pools
No contingency for rural transport or weather

label: Budget reasonableness
description: Present a line-item budget that is reasonable, allowable, and tied to the scope of work.

scoring.desc: Budget is a lump sum or contains unallowable costs.
Budget has line items but unit costs or personnel allocations are not justified.
Budget ties every line to activities with justified unit costs and a clear indirect rate.

common_failures: Personnel hours do not reconcile with the work plan

label: Community partnership
description: Show partnerships with Mat-Su health, tribal, school, or social-service organizations with documented roles.

scoring.desc: Partners are named but roles are unclear or letters are generic.
Partners have defined roles but no signed MOUs.
Partners have signed MOUs, defined roles, and a shared governance or communication plan.

common_failures: Partner letters that are general endorsements
Partners with no resource or role commitment
Missing tribal partner for projects serving tribal citizens
